{"notes": "Visit 5 (7:45). Nobody spoke while I was there, and no hands are labeled. The picture is unchanged from visit 4: every domino is dark and connected to the start, with nothing pale or stranded. Body, nose curl, bottom line, upper tail lobe and lower tail lobe are all in place. The tail is open, so the run should fall cleanly. I still haven't seen anyone place a domino, so ratings rest on results and on what people said, not on direct observation.

Maya: Set the direction with the fish idea, and her upper lobe and final checks on the top lobe and start join held up. Staying hands-off at the end was sensible. Execution solid, leadership good, impact good.

Tom: Delivered the bottom line, handed off to Leo cleanly, and kept coordination tight by asking Leo to shout when the lobe was down. The earlier talk-over-build pattern and late start are outweighed by the result. Collaboration strong, impact good.

Priya: Status updates were accurate and the nose joint check held up. I never saw her build. Ratings stay provisional at solid but unproven. Ask her privately about her sketch and what she built.

Leo: The lower lobe went up after the 3:45 handoff, he reported it at 5:15, and the picture confirms it is connected. His idle time looks dependency-driven. Ask him privately what he built and whether he could have started sooner. Execution good, collaboration good.

Team: Finished on time with a clean connection. In the review, ask whether anyone helped Leo while he waited, and wait for the push-over result before finalizing."}
